svg.title: SDOA MCP Hybrid Pipeline — Full Architecture
svg.text: LAYER 1 — MCP TOOLS (one per sovereign phase)
Each phase checkpoints to disk before advancing. Runs are resumable.
State file: state.json | Outputs: analysis.json → verification.json
sdoa.run.reset(runId, phase) rewinds to any completed checkpoint.
Invoked by: ANALYZE (detect), AUDIT (enforce hard), VERIFY (final gate). All violations are structured errors — never warnings.
Seeded from master.manifest.json on startup. Rebuilt on ANALYZE. Cached to .sdoa/cache/graph-cache.json.
state.json + analysis → verification outputs (one JSON per phase)
OPEN: "svx tools" — clarification needed to place in architecture
Is "svx" = SDOAvX native utilities, an external library, or a separate toolset? Answer determines Layer 5 placement.
